dev-c-greenhouse-sensor-hub.statement: Four analog probe acquisition channels reach screw-terminal inputs.
The I2C expansion bus reaches two Qwiic receptacles.
A controller owns the acquisition functions.
Power and fault LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-ph-electrode-conditioner.statement: The BNC input is buffered to the BNC output with adjustable calibration.
Input and output use two BNC connectors.
The power LED has a current-limited circuit.

dev-c-vibration-sensor-bridge.statement: The sensor and host Qwiic ports share the required I2C bridge path.
One motion-event counting channel is present.
Activity and fault LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-duct-temperature-panel.statement: Three thermistor acquisition channels reach screw terminals.
The controller publishes local readings on the I2C display path.
A current-limited status LED circuit is present.

dev-c-isolated-pulse-reader.statement: Two isolated field pulse channels reach the logic controller.
The field inputs preserve isolation on their delivered signal paths.
Two screw-terminal field inputs are fitted.
Two activity LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-solar-irradiance-reader.statement: The sensor input accepts 0 to 10 V.
The BNC sensor input is acquired and reported on the Qwiic path.
A BNC sensor connector is fitted.
A current-limited power LED is present.

dev-c-hall-tachometer.statement: Two sensor pulse-count channels are present.
Both hall inputs reach the controller.
Two screw-terminal sensor connectors are fitted.
A USB service connector is fitted.
Two current-limited status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-rain-gauge-logger.statement: The tipping-bucket screw terminal reaches one pulse-input channel.
The pulse input reaches the controller and the Qwiic reporting port.
A current-limited pulse LED is present.

dev-c-load-cell-front-end.statement: The front end operates from 5 V.
The four-wire bridge input is conditioned to the analog output.
A screw-terminal bridge connector is fitted.
A Qwiic digital-readout path is present.
A current-limited power LED is present.

dev-c-current-loop-monitor.statement: Each input accepts a 4 to 20 mA current loop.
Four digitized loop acquisition channels are present.
All loop channels reach the controller.
Four screw-terminal sensor inputs are fitted.
Two current-limited status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-irrigation-valve-panel.statement: Four independently controlled valve channels are present.
The controller reaches all valve outputs.
Four screw-terminal valve outputs are fitted.
A USB service connector is fitted.
Four current-limited zone LED circuits are present.

dev-c-dual-fan-controller.statement: Two PWM outputs and two tachometer inputs are present.
Fan PWM, tachometer, and Qwiic temperature-sensor paths reach the controller.
Two current-limited fan-status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-rs485-wall-controller.statement: The differential field bus reaches the local controller.
A three-position screw terminal is fitted for the field bus.
Bus-activity and fault LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-can-service-adapter.statement: CAN reaches the USB configuration interface through a switchable terminator.
Transmit and receive LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-two-motor-test-jig.statement: Two independently controlled motor channels are present.
The controller reaches both motor outputs.
Screw terminals are fitted for power and motors.
Two current-limited activity LED circuits are present.

dev-c-eight-output-i2c-module.statement: Eight independently controlled outputs are present.
Both Qwiic ports reach all output control paths.
Eight current-limited output LED circuits are present.

dev-c-four-pulse-generator.statement: Four independently adjustable pulse-output channels are present.
All pulse channels reach the output header.
A USB service connector is fitted.
A current-limited power LED is present.

dev-c-usb-macro-keypad.statement: Twelve independently scanned key channels are present.
All twelve buttons reach the controller and USB interface.
Three current-limited status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-timed-valve-controller.statement: Two independently timed valve channels are present.
Both timed outputs and the Qwiic display path reach the controller.
Two current-limited zone LED circuits are present.

dev-c-addressable-sign-controller.statement: Sixteen LED data positions are present in one complete chain.
The Qwiic host, LED-strip connector, and serial LED data chain reach the controller.
A USB service connector is fitted.
Two current-limited status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-six-lamp-annunciator.statement: Six independent LED channels and their six button inputs are present.
Each pushbutton and LED channel reaches the controller.
Six current-limited LED circuits are present.
A USB service connector is fitted.

dev-c-machine-state-display.statement: Qwiic host data reaches the I2C display and four alert outputs through the controller.
Four current-limited alert LED circuits are present.

dev-c-twelve-pixel-grid.statement: Twelve LED data positions form a complete serial chain.
The serial LED chain is electrically complete.
The twelve pixels occupy a 3 by 4 rectangular grid.
A USB service connector is fitted.
Two current-limited status LED circuits are present.

dev-c-round-status-beacon.statement: The beacon has a 42 mm circular outline.
Four current-limited LED channels are present.
The controller drives all beacon LED channels.

dev-c-qwiic-alarm-display.statement: Both Qwiic ports reach the display, alarm LEDs, and controller.
Three current-limited alarm LED circuits are present.

dev-c-eight-cue-led-bar.statement: Eight cue LED channels are independently controlled.
The controller reaches all cue LED outputs.
Eight current-limited indicator LED circuits are present.
A USB service connector is fitted.

dev-c-serial-front-desk-display.statement: The differential serial input reaches the controller and local display.
A three-position screw terminal is fitted.
Receive and fault LED circuits are current limited.

dev-c-four-zone-scoreboard.statement: Four independent display zones are present.
The controller reaches every display zone and mode input.
Four current-limited zone-marker LED circuits are present.
A USB service connector is fitted.

dev-c-hexagonal-alert-tile.statement: The tile has a hexagonal outline.
The Qwiic command path reaches the controller and all alert outputs.
Six current-limited alert LED circuits are present.
A current-limited power LED is present.

dev-c-panel-label-reader.statement: The controller connects the Qwiic host, I2C display, encoder, and navigation inputs.
Two current-limited status LED circuits are present.
The board has a rounded-rectangle outline.

dev-p-fused-12v-distribution.statement: The board accepts a 12 V DC input.
Four individually fused two-pin outputs are provided.
A power indicator LED is wired as a complete circuit.

dev-p-usbc-5v-field-split.statement: A USB-C receptacle provides the 5 V input.
The input is rated for 2 A.
Three locking outputs each have resettable-fuse protection.

dev-p-24v-reverse-input.statement: The protected input path supports 2 A.
Reverse-polarity protection and a replaceable input fuse protect the input.
A two-pin output terminal and power-good LED are provided.

dev-p-12v-5v-buck-terminal.statement: The converter supplies 5 V at 1.5 A.
The output is rated for at least 1.5 A.
Separate input and output terminals, an input fuse, and a power LED are provided.

dev-p-18v-3v3-logic-supply.statement: The board accepts 18 V DC input.
The regulated output is 3.3 V and rated for 800 mA.
The 3.3 V rail supports at least 800 mA.
A keyed input, 3.3 V output header, reverse-input protection, and status LED are provided.

dev-p-dual-5v-fuse-panel.statement: The panel distributes 5 V input power.
The common input supports 2 A total.
Two separately fused instrument outputs are provided.
Each output has an independent output-present LED.

dev-p-9v-load-switch.statement: The board accepts a 9 V supply.
The switched load path supports 1 A.
A three-pin logic header controls the load output.
The input is reverse protected and an enabled indicator LED is wired.

dev-p-12v-sequenced-outputs.statement: The distribution board accepts 12 V at 2 A.
The second switched output remains off until the first output is enabled.
Both outputs are resettable-fuse protected and have separate LEDs.

dev-p-24v-isolated-5v-module.statement: The isolated output is 5 V and supports 500 mA.
The output is rated for at least 500 mA.
Input and output returns remain isolated and an output-present LED is wired.

dev-p-12v-aux-rail-board.statement: The board accepts 12 V through a common terminal.
One output is regulated to 5 V at 1 A.
One protected raw 12 V output supports 1 A.
A master fuse and rail-presence LEDs protect and indicate both outputs.

dev-p-bridge-sensor-front-end.statement: The bridge interface operates from 5 V.
A four-pin bridge terminal reaches the instrumentation amplifier.
An adjustable zero trim is provided.
A ground-referenced single-ended analog output spans 0 to 3.3 V.

dev-p-4to20ma-receiver.statement: The board receives a 4 to 20 mA loop at 24 V.
The analog output spans 0 to 3.3 V.
Input transient protection, a precision sense resistor, and an output status LED are fitted.

dev-p-dual-mic-preamp.statement: Two microphone preamplifier channels have microphone headers and adjustable gain.
Both channels reach the AC-coupled line-output header.
A shared power LED is wired.

dev-p-line-level-dual-buffer.statement: The line receiver operates from 5 V.
Stereo 3.5 mm input and output jacks are fitted.
Two unity-gain buffered audio channels connect input to output.
The inputs are protected, outputs are AC coupled, and a power LED is wired.

dev-p-thermistor-quad-interface.statement: The thermistor interface operates from 3.3 V.
Four labelled thermistor channels connect sensor terminals to the analog output header.
Every thermistor channel has a bias resistor and RC filter.

dev-p-piezo-impact-interface.statement: The piezo interface operates from 3.3 V.
A two-pin piezo terminal reaches the amplifier input with bipolar excursion protection.
An adjustable gain trimmer is fitted.
An analog output header and trigger LED are provided.

dev-p-10v-process-input.statement: A 0 to 10 V field input is conditioned to a 0 to 3.3 V output.
The field terminal input is protected and the output is filtered.

dev-p-photodiode-transimpedance.statement: The transimpedance amplifier operates from 5 V.
The two-pin detector connector reaches a buffered analog output.
The output includes a 10 kHz low-pass filter.

dev-p-guitar-input-buffer.statement: One 6.35 mm input jack and one 6.35 mm output jack are fitted.
The signal path is high impedance, unity gain, and AC coupled at the output.
Reverse-polarity protection and a power LED are included.

dev-p-anti-alias-dual-channel.statement: The anti-alias interface operates from 3.3 V.
Two input channels reach the shared filtered output header.
Each channel has a 1 kHz low-pass corner.

dev-p-dual-brushed-motor-driver.statement: The motor controller accepts 6 to 12 V.
Two motor terminals are driven from the logic control header.
The input is reverse protected and a power LED is wired.

dev-p-pwm-fan-controller.statement: The two fan outputs support 1 A total.
Two four-wire fan headers are controlled from the three-pin control header.
Tachometer outputs for both fans and a power LED are provided.

dev-p-solenoid-low-side-quad.statement: Four two-pin coil terminals are controlled from the logic header.
Every coil channel has flyback protection and its own LED.

dev-p-linear-actuator-hbridge.statement: The H-bridge supports a 2 A actuator.
The actuator terminal, limit-switch header, and logic-control header are connected for reversible drive.
Reverse-input protection and a fault LED are provided.

dev-p-stepper-module-carrier.statement: The carrier accepts a 12 V supply.
A plug-in stepper driver module reaches the four-wire motor terminal and logic header.

dev-p-servo-power-injector.statement: The injector distributes 6 V servo power.
Four three-pin servo outputs each have resettable-fuse protection.

dev-p-24v-valve-pulse-driver.statement: Two valve terminals are controlled from the trigger header.
Both channels have flyback protection and visible active-channel LEDs.

dev-p-dc-pump-controller.statement: A command header controls the two-pin pump output.
A current-sense analog output, reverse protection, flyback path, and running LED are included.

dev-p-encoder-motor-interface.statement: The encoder interface operates from 5 V.
The six-pin quadrature encoder input reaches the six-pin buffered output header.
The output signals are 3.3 V compatible.
RC filtering and a power LED are included.

dev-p-vibration-motor-driver.statement: The vibration-motor driver operates from 5 V.
Four motor headers are controlled from the logic header.
Every motor channel has flyback protection and an activity LED.
